scope: RERoT off, one ordinary generation stream; no CPU single-thread restriction
goal: Raise measured throughput and replace the bandwidth-only reference by a independently calibrated cost prediction; never define an unexplained residual as an achieved match.
baseline: APEX unchanged weights, five RX6800, attention head-sharded, no MTP, aggressive, MMVQ disabled, threads22
screen_rule: Exploration only. Preserve output/quality failures. Protocol, load or abnormal exit stops the sweep, not silently replaced. Candidate must be independently confirmed against baseline.

confirmation.primary: sum(predicted_ms)/sum(public completion tokens); paired log ratios, Student t CI df3

theory.original: weight-only ideal, 273.86 tps, unchanged historical definition
theory.new: Separate hardware bound from calibrated implementation prediction; calibrate on disjoint timing/shape measurements then freeze before held-out requests.
theory.match_criterion: Prediction within 5% on every predeclared held-out process; report signed errors and unchanged quality gates. This is a model-validation criterion, not hardware-optimality proof.

safety: Retain VkBuffer identity, epochs/extents/payload checks, bank ownership, native drains and original timeouts. No clock/driver/watchdog/reset changes. One GPU owner, no concurrent compilation. No commits.
